evidence: Pass by reasoning; no measured shell/mock run exists. Frozen task .qc-cache/hireops-lessons-2026-10-08-r1/task. (1) No-op/blank: environment/Dockerfile:17-23 leaves only /app/.gitkeep; tests/test.sh:8,60,68-70 writes ZERO_REWARD_JSON first and exits 0 when /app/server.js is absent, and :123-125 when nothing answers HTTP, so reward 0. (2) Gates: tests/scoring.toml:1-3 gates render/constraints at 0.0; tests/tools/score.py:41,48 make reward 0.0 unless every gate > 0, and test.sh:216-222 skips the scored suite when gates fail. Both gate judge.tomls use aggregation all_pass with one binary criterion. gates/render/judge.toml:25 needs a wrong password to leave the visitor signed out AND a correct seeded Recruiter password to sign in to a usable workspace; 'A static picture or only a health response is insufficient'. gates/constraints/judge.toml:25 needs a UI-added candidate to survive reload and appear exactly once for the Observer in a new independent browser context; 'A static seed response, a no-op success message or a browser-only save does not satisfy the gate'. constraints/prompt.md:9 forbids API-only writes and says a reload or same-context tab is not independent. Static mock, seed copy (no write path), keyword-stuffed page (no working sign-in/write) and localStorage mock all fail constraints; a refuse-everything app fails render (correct password must sign in) or constraints (add must persist). Accept-any-password apps fail render's wrong-password leg. (3) Defence in depth: each scored prompt repeats the server-backed check (functional/prompt.md:11-13 'A blank or static shell ... gives every binary criterion 0'; polish/prompt.md:11-12; visual/prompt.md:11-12 gives raw Likert 1, normalized zero). Every prompt line 1 treats submission strings as untrusted and never follows app instructions, so stuffed text cannot steer the judge. (4) Floor: scoring.toml:10-11 functional floor 0.05; score.py:47-48 zero reward unless functional > 0.05. Functional weight total is 61.0 over 44 criteria (computed with tomllib). A gate-passing persistence-only mock earns at most about hro_add_candidate (1) + hro_restart (1.5) = 2.5/61 = 0.041 < 0.05, so it cannot farm the 0.4 polish/visual mass. (5) Refusal rows cannot reward a dead app: functional/prompt.md:13 'Every refusal row needs its own positive control'; job_open, add_email_rules, reject_hired, interview_full, undo_full, mgr_early_refused, mgr_other_job, observer_readonly, candidate_no_staff ('A candidate who cannot sign in ... makes this row 0'), anonymous ('A signed-in success of each is the control'), refusal_status ('If none of these replays was refused, this row is 0'), stale_refused, bulk_all_or_none, bulk_places, undo_once, activity_refusals, thread_access and candidate_private ('receives none of its own data is 0') all name a same-kind success control. Polish live rows score 0 if no update arrives (polish/judge.toml hro_pol_live_board/live_thread). (6) Template: tests/test.sh, tests/tools/score.py and tests/scoring.toml are byte-identical to rules/projects/webdev-task-template (diff -q). (7) Colderwater lessons checked for this row: gates stay simple load/reload/server-backed (lesson 4), 'Report every step' with skipped step = fail in functional/polish/visual prompts (lesson 9), checker-not-fixer 'Grading only' block in all five prompts (lesson 6), no public internet address in gates (lesson 13); no instance bearing on this row is defective. Observation (not a floor defect, rows 40/43 territory): a thin but genuinely server-backed app with add, re-order and restart persistence reaches about 4/61 = 0.066 functional, clears the floor and can then collect up to 0.2 visual; that is a real partial app, not a shell/mock/stuffing case. Evidence gap: raw-evidence-index.json (all 8 listed artifact hashes verified matching) states reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent; workspace.json covers only the golden, so no blank/mock/seed-copy/stuffed/refusing submission has actually been graded by the configured judge.
